judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant but ordinary daytime sky with fluffy clouds and vivid blue—nice to look at, but not memorable enough to keep in a curated collection.
strengths: strong contrast between blue sky and white clouds
weaknesses: no dramatic lighting or color variation
composition feels like a random patch without focal point
